# Place-Based Policy Wiki

> A RAG-first knowledge base on urban economics and city policy. 112 atomic claim cards from peer-reviewed literature with YAML metadata for tag-based filtering and relationship traversal. All URLs below return plain HTML with no JavaScript — fetch them directly.

## How to retrieve selectively

1. Read the LLM index page to see all 112 claims summarised in one page.
2. Read a synthesis hub for a thematic overview and curated claim list.
3. Fetch individual claim pages by ID — each is self-contained with evidence, qualifiers, and YAML metadata.
4. Follow `supports`/`qualifies`/`contradicts`/`depends_on` IDs in each claim's YAML block to traverse the evidence graph.
5. Fetch source pages for full bibliographic detail.

## Entry point

- [LLM index — all 112 claims summarised](https://richardfwalley.github.io/llm-place-based-policy/llm-index/): Start here — rendered HTML, full claim summaries grouped by source, links to every page

## Plain HTML files (no JavaScript, fetch directly)

### Claims (individual — fetch by ID)

- [claim-0001](https://richardfwalley.github.io/llm-place-based-policy/plain/claims/claim-0001.html): Doubling city size → 2.7–6.4% wage/productivity gain (median 4.6%)
- [claim-0011](https://richardfwalley.github.io/llm-place-based-policy/plain/claims/claim-0011.html) through [claim-0112](https://richardfwalley.github.io/llm-place-based-policy/plain/claims/claim-0112.html): see plain HTML index for full list
